Clean up your iPhone and organize your storage smarter with CleanX.

From duplicate photos and similar videos to large files, overflowing inboxes, and messy contact lists, CleanX helps you remove unnecessary clutter, free up storage space, and keep your iPhone organized with less effort. Whether your iPhone storage full warning keeps appearing or you simply want to clean out your phone faster, CleanX helps make storage management easier and more organized.

REMOVE DUPLICATE PHOTOS & CLEAN VIDEOS FASTER
Your gallery can quickly fill up with duplicate photos, similar images, repeated videos, screenshots, bursts, and unnecessary media that take up valuable storage space.
Remove duplicate photos and similar images, clear repeated videos, sort large files by size, and free up storage space more efficiently without manually searching through your gallery.

SWIPE THROUGH PHOTOS TO CLEAN UP IN SECONDS
Organizing your gallery should feel simple and natural.
Swipe through photos to quickly decide what to keep and what to remove without spending hours scrolling through your camera roll. If you are looking for how to clear up space on iPhone, CleanX helps simplify the entire cleanup process.

FIND LARGE FILES & FREE UP STORAGE SPACE
Large videos and storage-heavy files can silently consume your phone storage. Get more storage on iPhone by identifying large and unnecessary files taking up space in your gallery.

REDUCE VIDEO SIZE WITHOUT LOSING QUALITY
Save storage without losing important memories.
Compress videos to reduce file sizes while maintaining visual quality and choose exactly which videos you want to optimize.

CLEAN UP EMAIL CLUTTER IN SECONDS
An overloaded inbox can become difficult to manage.
CleanX helps you remove spam, promotional emails, and unnecessary messages so your mailbox feels cleaner, lighter, and easier to organize.

ORGANIZE CONTACTS & BACK THEM UP SECURELY
Merge duplicate contacts, remove unnecessary contact information, create secure backups, and restore previous contact lists anytime with less effort.

KEEP PERSONAL FILES SAFE & PRIVATE
Keep personal photos and videos protected inside a secure private space designed for sensitive content you want to keep separate from your gallery.

ADD CHARGING ANIMATIONS & USEFUL HOME WIDGETS
Make your iPhone feel more personal with stylish charging animations and practical Home Screen widgets for battery tracking, storage usage, and faster access to cleanup tools.

PRIVATE, SAFE & DESIGNED FOR CONTROL
Your privacy and control always come first.
CleanX is designed to help you clean, organize, and optimize your iPhone safely while keeping your personal data protected and fully under your control.

NO INTERNET NEEDED
CleanX works directly on your device, so you can clean and organize your iPhone anytime without needing an internet connection.
